name: Self-Organizing Map Dimensional Reduction for Transfer Functions
aliases: Multi-dimensional Transfer Function Design using Self-Organizing Maps
Self-Organizing Map (SOM) Dimensional Reduction for Transfer Functions
Self-Organizing Maps (SOM) for Transfer Function Design
definition: A method for designing multi-dimensional transfer functions by using self-organizing maps to perform dimensional reduction of voxel attributes (signatures), allowing users to interact with a simplified 2D or spherical map space instead of the high-dimensional attribute space.
summary: This method simplifies multi-dimensional transfer function design by mapping voxel signatures to a 2D map space via Self-Organizing Maps, enabling easier user interaction and non-discrete classification.
